Supademo makes interactive demos, free for five demos and from $38 per creator a month on yearly billing, and sells an AI demo agent as prepaid credits from $99. The agent shows Supademo’s captured demos, decks and videos. Tour alternatives include Storylane, Navattic, Arcade, HowdyGo and Guideflow. Agents that show the running product instead include Floe, Naoma, Rayko and Hyper AI. Every entry is checked against the vendor’s own site. [...] Does Supademo have an AI demo agent?+

Yes, as an add-on to its paid plans. It talks by voice and text, shows Supademo’s interactive demos, decks and videos, and is sold as prepaid credits from $99 for 1,400 credits, with 1,500 free credits to start.

What is the best Supademo alternative?+

For interactive demos, compare Storylane, Navattic, Arcade, HowdyGo and Guideflow. For an agent that shows the running product rather than captured demos, compare Floe, Naoma, Rayko and Hyper AI.

Is Floe a Supademo alternative?+

It is an alternative to Supademo’s agent, not to its interactive demos. Floe runs a live, voice-led demo in your real product, in English and Hindi, and does not publish a price.

Related comparisons [...] Products in this category change monthly, so confirm anything important with the vendor.

## How to choose a Supademo alternative

Are you replacing the demos or the agent? Tour tools replace Supademo’s interactive demos. AI demo agents replace its agent add-on. Decide which you are shopping for before comparing prices.

Captured content, or the product? Supademo’s agent and Walnut’s Buyer Xpert answer from captured demos. Floe, Naoma, Rayko and Hyper AI operate the real product, which needs a demo account they can sign in to.

Which plan has what you need? HTML capture, sandbox demos and SSO sit on different plans at each vendor. Storylane’s and Guideflow’s HTML demos start on their Growth plans, and so do Navattic’s sandbox demos. Price the plan you will actually use.

The best Supademo alternative depends on which limit you hit: Naoma for a live AI agent that demos the real product, Storylane for the biggest interactive-demo platform, Navattic for HTML fidelity, Arcade for design polish, Guideflow for the lowest entry price, and Demoboost for presales breadth with bundled services.
 Supademo genuinely earns its spot as the value pick of demo software — $38/creator/mo annual, a usable free tier, self-serve checkout — so a worthwhile alternative has to beat it on capability, not just cost.
 Its G2 complaint pattern is consistent: missing features and limited customization (~83 mentions), with 2026 reviewers adding narrow AI-voiceover accent options and friction on highly complex demos. [...] ## FAQ

What is the best Supademo alternative? For most teams it splits by need: Naoma if you want a live AI agent that demos the real product and bills per engaged demo, Storylane if you want the deepest interactive-demo platform, and Guideflow if you want the lowest paid entry at $35/mo annual.

Which Supademo alternative is the cheapest? Guideflow, at $35/mo annual — just under Supademo's own $38/creator entry — followed by Storylane at $40/mo annual and Arcade at $42.50/user/mo annual, though in all three cases the headline tier excludes the flagship features. [...] Do any Supademo alternatives have free plans? Yes — Storylane, Navattic, Arcade, and Guideflow all offer free tiers; Demoboost has neither a free tier nor a self-serve trial, and Naoma launches self-serve purchase with a free trial in September 2026.

Which alternatives include an AI agent that talks to buyers? Three of the six: Naoma (a live video agent driving the real product), Storylane (RepX, presenting Storylane captures), and Navattic (Agents, running on a clone of your product); Arcade, Guideflow, and Demoboost keep AI on the creation side only.

## Frequently Asked Questions about Naoma Alternatives

Commonly asked questions about this topic.

### What is the best Naoma alternative?

Supademo is the best overall Naoma alternative for teams that want an AI demo agent connected to a native demo automation platform, not just a video-led agent. Karumi is the closer fit if you specifically want live, call-style demos. With Supademo, you start with an interactive demo, then layer the AI Demo Agent on top.

### How much does Naoma cost? [...] ## The 6 best Naoma alternatives in 2026

Naoma's closest peer is a live AI demo agent. Its adjacent peers are demo platforms that added an agent layer, and AI sales agents where demos are one use case among several.

### 1. Supademo AI Demo Agent

Supademo AI Demo Agent lets GTM teams deploy a buyer-facing agent trained on approved content to run discovery, answer questions, surface interactive demos, videos, decks, docs, and proof points, qualify visitors, and route high-intent buyers. Unlike a standalone video agent, it lives inside a broader demo automation platform.

Try the Supademo AI demo agent yourself:

Where Supademo wins over Naoma AI [...] Honest limitations

Supademo does not currently offer AI video avatars or branded AI mascots. It is a stronger fit if you care more about controlled product storytelling, asset orchestration, and interactive product proof than avatar-led selling.

### 2. Karumi AI

Karumi is a YC-backed agentic demo platform where an AI agent joins prospects in a live video-call-style demo, navigates product flows, answers questions, and personalizes demos across languages. Self-Serve is $900/month for one agent, one language, and three seats, with no free plan; multi-language support and additional agents require a custom Enterprise quote.
